about: Attorney Michael “The Bull” Lamonsoff is one of the most successful and highest rated construction accident and personal injury attorney's in New York City. Widely recognized for handling high-stakes construction accidents, personal injury, and sexual abuse cases. Nicknamed “The Bull” for his aggressive, no-holds-barred approach, Mr. Lamonsoff has built a career fighting for maximum compensation in some of the highest-profile and largest personal injury cases in New York history.

If you’ve been injured in an accident in New York, you need an attorney who never backs down. You need Attorney Michael “The Bull” Lamonsoff. With over half a BILLION dollars recovered and some of the largest verdicts and settlements in New York, The Bull is known for taking charge-- and winning big for injury victims.

Whether you were injured in a construction accident, a slip-and-fall accident, a MTA bus or train crash, or you're a survivor of sexual abuse or assault, Michael fights for maximum compensation and lasting peace of mind . His relentless, trial-ready style puts pressure on insurance companies and punishes them to deliver the justice you deserve.
“I love to win. And my clients love me for it.” — Attorney Michael “The Bull” Lamonsoff

Michael Lamonsoff, Esq. is the founder of The Bull’s Millionaire’s Club. A group that honors the clients he’s fought for and won life-changing multi-million-dollar results. These verdicts and settlements represent dignity restored, financial relief, and a system forced to reckon with real people’s pain.

Michael’s no-holds-barred litigation style, paired with his team of elite former prosecutors and strategic litigators, makes him a formidable opponent for even the biggest insurance companies, hospitals, and government entities.
$16,000,000 verdict in a sexual abuse case-- one of the highest in NYC history

$8,000,000+ secured for multiple public transit accident victims
$6,500,000 settlement just before trial for an injured construction worker
He’s also represented victims in some of New York’s highest-profile disasters:
Major Metro-North and Amtrak train disasters
Michael doesn’t just take on cases, he takes down the powerful.
Construction Accidents (scaffolds, ladders, NYC Labor Law)
Sexual Abuse & Assault (schools, hospitals, jails, rehab facilities)
Premises Liability (slip and falls, ceiling collapses, security failures)
No matter how complex or high-stakes the case, Michael and his team go all in — pushing it to the edge of trial to maximize every dollar for you.

Attorney Michael Lamonsoff prepares every case as if it’s going to trial. Because that’s how he wins. Insurance companies fear juries and do everything they can to delay, hoping injured victims will settle for less. Michael knows their game — and beats them at it.
“They delay. They deny. But the closer we get to trial, the more money they offer. That’s why our clients say: ‘It’s Worth the Wait with The Bull!’ ” — Michael S. Lamonsoff
